title: Power Rankings: Texas takes top spots again
heading: 2010-11 Power Rankings: Week 16
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: The Spurs ain't messin' around, even with that big lead over the rest of the West. How do we know? Pop responded to that one wack night in Philly with the first change to the starting lineup he's made all season.
